home.name: poster cover: huge name, 12-unit ruler, 12 x 8 grid, G toggles coordinates (not while typing)
home.js: (function(){ var live=innerWidth>960; var t=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#home .hero__title')).fontSize); var ruler=document.querySelectorAll('#home .sx-ruler span').length===12; if(!live) return ruler && t>=60; var root=document.documentElement; var cells=document.querySelectorAll('.sx-grid .sx-cell').length===96; var g=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.sx-grid')); var tracks=g.gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').length===12 && g.gridTemplateRows.split(' ').length===8; var before=root.classList.contains('sx-coords'); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'g',bubbles:true})); var on=root.classList.contains('sx-coords'); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'g',bubbles:true})); var off=!root.classList.contains('sx-coords'); var inp=document.querySelector('#contact input'); inp.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'g',bubbles:true})); var typing=!root.classList.contains('sx-coords'); var cap=document.querySelector('.sx-cap').textContent; var snap=getComputedStyle(root).scrollSnapType.indexOf('y')===0; return ruler && t>=170 && cells && tracks && !before && on && off && typing && snap && /Sheet \d\d \/ 06, .+, grid 12/.test(cap) && /Red circle [A-L][1-8]/.test(cap) && document.querySelectorAll('.sx-rail a').length>=7; })()

about.name: lead, text and facts placed on grid columns (stacked on phones)
about.js: (function(){ var l=document.querySelector('#about .about__lead').getBoundingClientRect(); var t=document.querySelector('#about .about__cols > .col-6').getBoundingClientRect(); var f=document.querySelector('#about .facts').getBoundingClientRect(); if(innerWidth<=960) return f.top>=t.top+t.height-2 && l.width>=innerWidth*0.7; var g=document.querySelector('.sx-grid').getBoundingClientRect(); var cw=g.width/12; return Math.abs(l.left-(g.left+3*cw))<2 && Math.abs(t.left-(g.left+3*cw))<2 && Math.abs(f.left-(g.left+8*cw))<2 && f.top<=t.top+4 && f.left>t.right-2 && parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#about .section__num')).fontSize)>=70; })()

experience.name: timeline drawn to scale on a 2020 to 2026 axis, bars placed from the dates
experience.js: (function(){ var ax=[].map.call(document.querySelectorAll('#experience .sx-axis li'),function(n){return n.textContent;}).join(',')==='2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025,2026'; var jobs=document.querySelectorAll('#experience .job'); var bars=document.querySelectorAll('#experience .sx-bar'); if(!ax||bars.length!==jobs.length||jobs.length<2) return false; var fr=[].map.call(bars,function(b){var l=b.parentNode.getBoundingClientRect(); var r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); return {s:(r.left-l.left)/l.width,e:(r.right-l.left)/l.width};}); var jul2026=fr[0].s>0.9 && fr[0].s<0.95; var jan2021=fr[1].s>0.13 && fr[1].s<0.15; var y2020=fr[2].s<0.01; var openEnd=fr.every(function(x){return Math.abs(x.e-1)<0.01;}); var lanes=document.querySelectorAll('#experience .sx-lane'); var same=[].every.call(lanes,function(n){return Math.abs(n.getBoundingClientRect().width-lanes[0].getBoundingClientRect().width)<1;}); return jul2026 && jan2021 && y2020 && openEnd && same; })()

projects.name: index of projects; the open project's detail on the right half (one open at a time)
projects.js: (function(){ var ps=document.querySelectorAll('#projects .project'); var open=[].filter.call(ps,function(p){return p.open;}); if(innerWidth<=960) return parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#projects .project__idx')).fontSize)>=22 && open.length<=1; if(open.length!==1) return false; var box=document.querySelector('#projects .projects').getBoundingClientRect(); var b=open[0].querySelector('.project__body').getBoundingClientRect(); var s=open[0].querySelector('summary').getBoundingClientRect(); var inv=getComputedStyle(open[0].querySelector('summary')).backgroundColor!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; var second=ps[1]; second.querySelector('summary').click(); var after=[].filter.call(ps,function(p){return p.open;}); var swapped=after.length===1 && after[0]===second; ps[0].querySelector('summary').click(); return b.left>=box.left+box.width*0.49 && s.right<=box.left+box.width*0.51 && b.height>150 && inv && swapped; })()

skills.name: bars scaled to data-level across the four-column group
skills.js: (function(){ function w(l){var li=document.querySelector('#skills .skill-list li[data-level="'+l+'"]'); var a=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(li,'::after').width); return {a:a,li:li.getBoundingClientRect().width};} var w4=w(4); var w2=w(2); var w3=w(3); var ratio=w4.a/w2.a; var frac=w4.a/w4.li; if(!(Math.abs(ratio-2)<0.08 && Math.abs(frac-0.8)<0.03 && Math.abs(w3.a/w3.li-0.6)<0.03)) return false; var h3=document.querySelector('#skills .skills__group h3'); var heading=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(h3).borderBottomWidth)>=4; if(innerWidth<=960) return heading; var gs=document.querySelectorAll('#skills .skills__group'); var g=document.querySelector('.sx-grid').getBoundingClientRect(); var cw=g.width/12; var cols=[].every.call(gs,function(n,i){return Math.abs(n.getBoundingClientRect().left-(g.left+i*4*cw))<2;}); return heading && cols && gs.length===3; })()

education.name: four year-cells in one row (a column on phones)
education.js: (function(){ var it=document.querySelectorAll('#education .edu__item'); if(it.length!==4) return false; var tops=[].map.call(it,function(n){return Math.round(n.getBoundingClientRect().top);}); var d=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#education .edu__date')).fontSize); var lab=[].map.call(it,function(n){return n.getAttribute('data-sx-c');}).join(',')==='A3,D3,G3,J3'; if(innerWidth<=960) return tops.every(function(t,i){return i===0||t>tops[i-1];}) && d>=28 && lab; var one=tops.every(function(t){return Math.abs(t-tops[0])<2;}); var w=[].map.call(it,function(n){return n.getBoundingClientRect().width;}); var eq=w.every(function(x){return Math.abs(x-w[0])<2;}); return one && eq && d>=40 && lab; })()

contact.name: giant stacked links with arrows; compact two-column form on the sheet
contact.js: (function(){ var as=document.querySelectorAll('#contact .contact__links a'); var fs=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(as[0]).fontSize); var arrow=getComputedStyle(as[0],'::after').content.indexOf('\u2192')>-1; var tops=[].map.call(as,function(a){return a.getBoundingClientRect().top;}); var stacked=tops.every(function(t,i){return i===0||t>tops[i-1]+20;}); if(innerWidth<=960) return fs>=22 && arrow && stacked; var f=document.querySelector('#contact .form').getBoundingClientRect(); var last=as[as.length-1].getBoundingClientRect(); return fs>=60 && arrow && stacked && f.top>last.bottom-4 && getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#contact .form')).display==='grid'; })()
